notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
First and foremost we want to give a heartfelt thank you to our amazing community, your enthusiasm and support for our titles has been a constant reminder why we do what we love— creating awesome games. As a lot of you know we are a small indie studio, and as we continue to work on several projects, we have to reassess where we need to focus our priority, and with that we will need to pause development of the Slender: The Arrival DLC, mod support and multiplayer. While we hope to revisit this content in the future we do need to shift our focus so we do not stretch our staff too thin. 

We appreciate your support and will continue to work hard on all our titles.

- Blue Isle Studios Team

notes.title: An update from the Slender: The Arrival development team:
notes.content:
We have made the decision to delay the addition of new DLC chapters, multiplayer and cross-platform mods coming to Slender: The Arrival. Our team is working on multiple projects, and to ensure we have not stretched our team too far we are looking at a slightly longer development period. Rest assured, we plan to deliver a really unique experience within Slender: The Arrival, and with more time our team can hit the right quality mark.

We appreciate all the feedback from our community, and we can not wait to update you all as more news develops.

We encourage you to join our Blue Isle Studios community Discord to stay up to date with the studio.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/b8e79bb32e9f02efddc41a9dadda39f42d9aaee5.png

notes.title: Slender: The Arrival - Labor of Love
notes.content:
We wanted to put Slender: The Arrival forth for consideration for the Labor of Love award. As you likely know, we have been hard at work building the 10th Anniversary Update which launched on October 18 as a free upgrade.

We’ve been blown away by the responses from all of you since the update dropped, and we can’t thank you enough for sticking with us throughout the last ten years. This marks a whole decade since our original release and we thought it was a perfect time to go back and revisit the first game we launched as a studio.

Your responses have truly energized our whole team, and that makes our jobs so much more rewarding. We are kicking things up a notch next year by adding a multiplayer mode, cross-platform modding, and even more chapters. This is a big undertaking, but these are updates we have been waiting a really long time to build.

We are incredibly passionate about this game, the mythos and the entire community and we hope you are all just as excited as we are. Our goal is to turn this into something sustainable, with continued updates months and years into the future. So, we humbly ask that you consider a vote for Slender: The Arrival in this year’s Steam “Labor of Love” nominations. It would mean a lot to us, and look forward to growing the game alongside you!


- The entire Blue Isle Studios team

notes.title: Slender Scares - Halloween 2023
notes.content:
Firstly, thank you to everyone who has played the Anniversary Update, we have been gathering a lot of feedback to improve your gameplay experience, adding quality-of-life updates and fixing bugs. But that’s not all, we have a devilish treat in store for you in today’s patch. Get ready because Halloween has Arrived…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/243e4e323f279c039199e5c81f5207bf58a25618.png

Trick or Treat?
Halloween has swept its way into Slender: The Arrival. You may start seeing some newly added Halloween decorations hung up around Kate’s house to spruce up the place. Who knows, maybe someone may come around for some trick-or-treating?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/811665b6d570d97cb85163b8e1dd626f97adedbf.gif

Sightings of faceless pumpkins have been reported and are scattered all around the game. Be sure to pick them up along your journey, they will make collecting 8 pages look like a piece of candy. Do not be fooled into thinking this a trick, Slender Man is waiting for you to collect them all. Once you have obtained all 30 pumpkins, Slender Man has a delicious treat in store, but he’s shy and needs some convincing to show it off this year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/b790f68af26cf5ad70f4a9a78ec92dcc7efcfb6c.gif

Slender Man’s Treat
Slender Man has prepared a wonderful surprise for all of you, however only the bravest souls will be able to unlock this new mystery. Collect all 30 faceless pumpkins scattered throughout the game to reveal Slender Man’s Halloween costume. Once all pumpkins have been obtained, an option in the gameplay settings will be revealed to show his costume. Turn it on and hop into any level with Slender Man and try to find him. It’ll surely be a surprise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/a81572773da049e044f4d424421a5d114f0f1495.png


Now on to today’s patch notes!

Performance Changes
 Improved performance for mid and low end machines
 Fixed a bug that caused max view distance to be 10x further than anticipated
 Fixed a bug that caused resolution scale to work unreliably
 Added PSO cache for SM5 to smooth out hitches on lower end machines. (SM6 already had this)
 Added occlusion culling for low end devices where nanite is not present
 Upgraded DLSS and Streamline plugins to 5.3
Gameplay
 Added camera shake when looking at slender to better represent the original (can be turned off using the "camera animations" setting.
 Improved Slender's AI.
 He can no longer be stared at for a long time,
 He chases more often without teleporting away.
 He has a chance to teleport when in view after 6 pages.
 Fixed situations where players can be insta-killed unfairly
Bug Fixes
 Removed context ping from single player levels
 Fixed an issue where the radio tower appears low poly
 Fixed missing overhead garage door at Kate's house
 Fixed a bug where charlie would not appear in the burnt down house
 Fixed a bug where a scream would not be heard when going through the gate if no page picked up
 Fixed a bug that caused Kate's house to lose proper reflections
 Fixed some reported game crashes
 Fixed a bug where charlie could be kited in homestead on normal and easy difficulties
 Fixed a bug where water would show coloured spotty patterns when viewed at certain angles
 Fixed a bug where 'Flashback' would spawn the player in the tape room on second playthrough
 Fixed multiple instances where the camera would not render on the player's shadow
 Fixed a bug where the player could escape the final room in "The Arrival"
 Multiple typo and spelling mistake fixes
 Fixed a bug where the final cutscene could be triggered by walking to a corner in the basement
 Fixed a bug where the charlie would not disappear from the staircase after picking up both notes in "The Arrival"
 Fixed multiple issues in a unnamed level
 Fixed an issue with light leaking into the cellar when it should pitch black.
 Fixed issues with base resolution scale causing confusion with DLSS negative performance
 Fixed visible seams in Kate's house (Escape)
Quality of Life Updates
 Added numerical representations to options sliders
 Removed look bindings from arrow keys (requires deleting axis bindings from gameusersettings.ini in user/local/slenderthearrival/saved/config)
 Added the ability to toggle the player's hud using the Tab key (or select on controller). This can be rebound.
 Lauren's height decreased a bit
 Slender's height increased a bit
 Slender's head and hands textures improved
 Slender's arms lengthened 
2023 Halloween Event - Slender Scares
 Added Halloween Decor
 Added 30 faceless pumpkins
 Added Slender's costume if 30 faceless pumpkins are found and setting is enabled in the gameplay menu

Blue Isle Studios Official Discord
Before we wrap up today’s update, we have put together our new Blue Isle Studios Discord. We put together this Discord for everyone to stay up to date with the latest developments from our studio and updates for our games. If you’re interested in joining please feel free to click the link below. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/b8e79bb32e9f02efddc41a9dadda39f42d9aaee5.png

If you’re interested in only following the studio and Slender: The Arrival updates you can do so by choosing the Slender: The Arrival role in the role-pick channel. We’ll continue to update our game announcements there, so be sure to choose the titles you would like to hear the latest development news from. 

And on that note we are all done for today. Enjoy today’s update, please keep sending us feedback and we will do our best to continue to bring you more scares! Good luck trick-or-treating!

notes.title: Slender: The Arrival 10th Anniversary Update is HERE!
notes.content:
Slender Man is back and we have just launched our next major update. Take a look at all of the details below. 

Key Features

Complete Visual Overhaul
Every shadow, every material, every model and hair raising encounter with the mysterious Slender Man is rerendered in stunning detail.

Multiple Language Support
We have redesigned pickups, readables and newly added subtitles ensure the horror can be experienced for the first time in multiple languages including: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Portuguese.

Play the Original
Swap between the original versions and the new update by switching branches on your Steam client, enjoy the original graphics, or experience the horror in all new detail. Learn how to swap between versions here.

Check out Slender: The Arrival's new launch trailer below!
[previewyoutube=hQ1d9NPcLsI;full][/previewyoutube]

Brand New Chapter

Those of you willing to brave the darkness will find a brand new chapter waiting for you. In the game’s new chapter; Nightmare, we follow Charlie Matheson’s father as he descends ever deeper into madness. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/c0c8a4cbe6a37b19a4bb1ee3ab679d50d1386f6a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/0ad90fcf2de0570aa7940777c4fb9eacbd3e8786.png

Future Development - 2024 Roadmap

In case you missed our previous post, we’ll share all of it again. The world of Slender: The Arrival is expanding and we are excited to announce the following new content is in development. We don’t have a firm release date for this yet, but we are targeting Q2 of 2024 for the release. 

Multiplayer is Coming - Face The Darkness Together
The darkness is relentless, and now you don’t have to face it alone. We’re excited to introduce a brand new way to play; a cooperative multiplayer mode. Team up with friends, look for clues and get out alive… assuming you all work together.

For the first time ever, you can team up with others to investigate the mythos of Slender Man as you attempt to run, hide, or even fight back if you dare. 

The Story Continues - Brand New Chapters
We are hard at work on a brand new DLC expansion containing three all-new chapters. The story of Slender: The Arrival is not done yet, with new regions to explore, characters to meet and horrors to survive. 

Cross-Platform Mod Kit - Create Your Own Nightmares
In partnership with CurseForge for Studios and our friends at Overwolf, we are proud to announce the Slender: The Arrival Creators Mod Kit.

Create your own scenarios and distribute them across every platform; PC, PlayStation 5, or Xbox Series X/S. Players can create single player experiences, or, leverage the brand new multiplayer mode to create online scenarios. The editor we ship will be very similar to the one used to develop the 10th Anniversary Update, giving you access to all of the same tools, AI, environment art, sound effects and everything used by our designers.

Contribute new stories and experiences to the mythos and share your nightmarish creations with players all around the world.

Steam Sale

For anyone who has yet to grab their own copy of Slender: The Arrival, please be aware that we will have a Steam sale starting today at 1PM EST today, Wednesday October 18th. Please keep that in mind if you wish to pick up a copy for you or a friend.

This brings us to the end of today’s announcement, we hope you all enjoy the latest update to Slender: The Arrival. Be sure to follow our social below to keep up with all of the latest and greatest announcements. 

Have fun and enjoy the scares! We’ll be watching…

Twitter: https://twitter.com/PlaySlenderTA
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100064319096479
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@BlueIsleStudio 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/blueislestudios

notes.title: Slender: The Arrival 10 Year Anniversary Update Launches October 18
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that the Slender: The Arrival 10 Year Anniversary Update will be launching on October 18!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/42187ae13dda7713dfc7a9758541fb5e413df3ec.png
A New Chapter Awaits, And It’s Free
Those of you willing to brave the darkness will find a brand new chapter waiting for you. Best of all, we are launching this as a free content addon. Take a look at a short teaser below.

[previewyoutube=pRHA0B7fpoU;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam Update is Free
We want to make sure that as many people as possible get to experience Slender: The Arrival in all of its enhanced glory. For that reason, we have made the decision to launch all of this as a free update to the original game. If you already own the game on Steam, there’s no new product to purchase. On October 18th, open up Steam and download the update, then jump back in and experience the horror all over again.

For those of you who wish to play the older version of the game, you’ll have the ability to switch versions through Steam. Scroll to the bottom of this news post for instructions on how that will be done. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/960ec912399d552b689a0081f6b8d0a7a7685edf.png
Price Adjustment
On October 18, we’ll be increasing the price on Steam from $9.99 USD to $19.99 USD to reflect the improved visuals and all of the new content and improvements we are adding as part of this major update. The latest generation of consoles, and any future platforms we add the game to will also reflect the updated $19.99 USD pricing. 

The last generation consoles, however, will remain priced at $9.99 USD as the new update is not launching on the older console hardware.

Multiple Languages Supported
We have redesigned how our pickups and readables work. Now, each pickup has the option to be viewed as an image, or you can select the ‘Read’ option to see the same pickup in text format. 

We have also added subtitles to audio, and contextual subtitle text that pops up when looking at certain narrative objects in the world.

With all of these new features we’ve finally been able to translate the game into multiple languages.

We’ll be supporting the following languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, and Portuguese. 

Future Development
This long awaited update has been something we have wanted to share for a long time, and we are totally blown away at all of the comments, reactions and discussions we have seen. We have big plans for future expansions to the game, and we’ll share more of that information as soon as we are ready. Stay tuned for our roadmap, Slender Man isn’t done yet…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/e967015053c3c4ecbc54d0f8c150470477ae88ff.gif

Switching Between Old and New Versions
For those of you who wish to experience the older version on Steam, you will have the ability to switch between the Anniversary Update and the original 2013 version by going to your Steam library and swapping branches.

To do this head to your Steam Library and locate ‘Slender: The Arrival’
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/6f04d6dba3f518a752993825c8737c48e45eb714.png

Click on the gear located to the left and click on ‘Properties’

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/c3953666078189702a297541fc4721343237507f.png

A pop up menu will appear, from here you’re going to click on the tab that says ‘Betas’ and on the right hand side you’ll see a drop down menu, click on that and choose an option: either ‘Version2013’ or ‘Version2015’. Each year represents a different version of the game, we wanted to leave them both available. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5188474/894ebfa80664b6a7fde5768a2a10b9f91f4f0755.png

Once done, Steam will begin to download and install the files for that version of the game. 

Follow these same instructions to swap back to the Anniversary Update, by clicking ‘none’ in the drop down section.

notes.title: Patch 1.5.4
notes.content:
Happy Friday the 13th!

We have scattered 13 candy canes throughout Slender: The Arrival for a limited time. Finding them gives you a chance to be drawn for a Steam Wallet Code! Here's how it works:

- You find all 13 candy canes and take a screenshot of each one
- Send your screenshots with descriptions to contests@blueislestudios.com
- We'll enter you in for a draw
- On December 28th, we'll end the contest and announce winners.

Technical Issues:

We bring to you a fix for the majority of your spinning or mouse sensitivity issues.

Secondly, for those of you receiving issues with lighting, we're still waiting on Unity. The issue can be found here: http://issuetracker.unity3d.com/issues/deferred-lighting-doesnt-work-on-intel-hd-graphics

Possible Workaround: Adding this flag "-force-d3d11" in the advanced launch options for the game in the steam client should make it run again.

This forces the unity engine the game to run in direct x 11 which appears to work fine with the new drivers and the Intel HD graphic cards.

Another possible workaround is to add the flag "-force-opengl" in the advanced launch options. Some users are mentioning performance gains.

We'll keep you updated, for now we've placed a disclaimer regarding Intel HD graphics on our store page.

notes.content:
Hey Guys,

In this latest fix we address some issues with our Steam Cloud integration. We've compressed several save files transferring between client-> server into a single file updated at game start/end.

Those who are still getting black screens at the beginning due to the Achievements string bug should be able to play normally with no adjustment made on your part.

As always, we will continue to observe and collect information for our next in-progress patch. We were hoping to bring our game to you on the newest version of Unity but unfortunately they have a number of issues to work out on their end before that will be possible.

Cheers! :)

notes.title: Patch 1.5.2
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

It's time for another batch of fixes. Expect more soon, but here's what we have for now:

-Version number has been corrected from 1.6 back to 1.5

-Fixed a problem where gaining an achievement could cause the game to improperly start up

-Fixed a problem where some of the game times were not being recorded on "Easy"

-Fixed a problem where our standalone license key system leaked into the steam build. The player should now be able to play in offline mode with no issues

-Fixed a bug where incomplete games would show up as completed on "Easy"

-Fixed a problem with "Into the Abyss" not recording players times

-Fixed a number of issues related to players being unable to get the "I'm Free" achievement

----

Issues on our minds which we currently have no ETA for:

-A few players are unable to get any lighting in their game

-Some machines with good hardware appear to be running poor frame rates on windows 8 and 8.1. While we do not support Windows 8 at this time and can make no promises, this is something we are looking into.

-Leaderboard times are not fully representing time taken to complete a level/game, making it seem shorter than it actually is.

notes.title: Patch 1.5.1
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

Wanted to get a few critical fixes out for you before the weekend. 

Here they are:

-Steam Cloud no longer kills local progress if local progress is greater. This means your progress should no longer be lost ever.

-Achievements are added to a queue. If the game fails to connect or message an achievement earned to steam, the game will remind steam on quit and on load of all achievements the user has gained.

-Debug is now turned off by default on game launch. This ensures that users do not get confused when achievements are not earned.

-Fixed an ability to exploit leaderboards with impossibly low scores.

-Fixed a couple leaderboards that were not properly populating with data.

-Adjusted sensitivity of joystick input. This will hopefully alleviate any issues with 3rd party controllers causing the player to spin in circles.

Your game should automatically update, but if it doesn't, you can simply restart steam. We'll update you soon when we have more fixes available.

Cheers,

Blue Isle Development Team
